python3 - <<'PY'
import json,subprocess,pathlib,sys
o=json.loads(subprocess.check_output(["docker","inspect","deploy-gaybbs-1"],text=True))[0]
labels=o.get("Config",{}).get("Labels") or {}
project=labels.get("com.docker.compose.project")
service=labels.get("com.docker.compose.service")
work=labels.get("com.docker.compose.project.working_dir")
files=labels.get("com.docker.compose.project.config_files","").split(",")
if project!="deploy" or service!="gaybbs" or not work or not pathlib.Path(work).is_dir():sys.exit(70)
if not files or any(not pathlib.Path(x).is_file() for x in files):sys.exit(71)
cmd=["docker","compose"]
for f in files:cmd+=["-f",f]
cmd+=["config","--services"]
p=subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=work,capture_output=True,text=True)
if p.returncode or "gaybbs" not in p.stdout.split():sys.exit(72)
subprocess.run(["docker","image","inspect","gace-gaybbs-video-doorway-repair:20261123"],check=True,stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL)
print("GAYBBS_COMPOSE_AND_NEW_IMAGE=VERIFIED")
PY
